title: Mariah Carey Reacts to News of Nick Cannon Wanting to Remarry Her Resurfaces
htmlContent:
Nick Cannon, the multi-talented entertainer known for his music, comedy, and television work, recently set the media abuzz when he expressed his willingness to remarry his ex-wife, Mariah Carey. In an interview on T.I.'s podcast, Cannon shared a sentiment that has left many intrigued: "If she say we going to the moon, I'd say, 'Let's go.'"

This statement from Cannon, who was married to Mariah Carey from 2008 to 2014, has reignited curiosity about their relationship and led fans to wonder whether a rekindling of their romance was in the cards. However, Mariah Carey, the iconic songstress, and five-time Grammy award winner, has now responded to Cannon's comments, and her stance on the matter appears to be quite different from his.

When asked about Cannon's remarks, Carey told TMZ, "Remarry? This is him making this up. This is him being silly." She also playfully quipped, "What is he, my last hope?" With these words, it's evident that she has a different perspective on the idea of remarrying her ex-husband.

Despite the candid nature of Cannon's statement, it's essential to understand the broader context of their relationship. After their divorce in 2014, the couple has managed to maintain a close and amicable bond, primarily for the sake of their two children, Moroccan and Monroe. Their dedication to co-parenting has been commendable, and their united front in raising their children has been a source of inspiration for many.

However, reconciling romantically might be off the horizon for Mariah Carey. Carey was recently in a relationship with Creative Director and Choreographer Brian Tanaka as of March 2023

Beyond her personal life, Carey remains a formidable force in the music and entertainment industry. She is currently on tour, continuing to showcase her vocal prowess and stage presence, much to the delight of her adoring fans. Additionally, the songbird is diligently working on new music, ensuring that her place in the music pantheon remains secure.

Furthermore, Carey is set to star in the upcoming Christmas movie, "All I Want for Christmas Is You," which is sure to delight both her longtime fans and those who are just discovering her legendary work.

Though she may not be open to remarrying Nick Cannon, Carey's support for him as a father and friend remains unwavering. She has expressed her happiness for his current state of life, and her well-wishes for him are a testament to the mutual respect and affection that continue to define their relationship.

Nick Cannon's openness to remarrying Mariah Carey may have garnered headlines, but it's clear that Mariah Carey has charted her own course, embracing the present and her new romance with Brian Tanaka. While their relationship might not take the path of matrimony, it is evident that their enduring friendship and shared commitment to parenting are hallmarks of their unique and special connection.
